story: Nina and Omar are in the classroom for their lesson. Mister Jack teaches them about geography and the alphabet. Nina writes a note with her pencil to help her remember. Omar reads a long sentence for his homework and prepares for a test.
title: A Day in the Classroom
setting: A bright classroom with desks and a chalkboard.

characters.name: Nina
characters.look: a girl with long black hair and a blue sweater

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: a boy with short brown hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Mister Jack
characters.look: a tall man with glasses and a green tie

sentences.en: Nina and Omar sit in the classroom.
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina with long black hair and Omar with short brown hair sit at desks in a bright classroom.

sentences.en: Mister Jack will teach a geography lesson.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mister Jack with glasses and a green tie stands by a chalkboard in a classroom.

sentences.en: He shows an example of the alphabet.
sentences.zh: 他展示了一个字母表的例子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mister Jack points to the letters A B C on a chalkboard.

sentences.en: Nina writes a note with her pencil.
sentences.zh: Nina用她的铅笔写下一条笔记。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina with long black hair writes on a piece of paper with a pencil.

sentences.en: Omar must repeat every new word.
sentences.zh: Omar必须重复每一个新单词。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar with short brown hair opens his mouth to speak in the classroom.

sentences.en: He can read a long sentence now.
sentences.zh: 他现在能读出一个长句子了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar looks at a book and reads a line of text.

sentences.en: He does his geography homework alone.
sentences.zh: 他独自做他的地理家庭作业。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar sits at a desk reading a book about maps and mountains.

sentences.en: He wants to pass the big test.
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar looks at a paper with many questions on his desk.

sentences.en: Do you know the answer yourself?
sentences.scene_prompt: Mister Jack looks at Omar and Nina with a kind smile.
